title_en: Close to the Prosecutor's Office of Tirana, 2+1 apartment for sale, newly invested and with perfect orientation!!!
description_en: Close to the Prosecutor's Office of Tirana, on Haxhi Hysen Dalliu street, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, newly invested and with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​93 m² and a net area of ​​83 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area and exit to the balcony, matrimonial room with dedicated toilet and exit to the balcony, children's room, balcony and central toilet with window. Orientation from the East and the West makes this light throughout the day. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment. The property has full mortgage documentation.
